criterion_1_finitude_vs_flat.description: compact finite cut complex: I(A:B) bounded in (0,log2]; flat product state: I(A:B)=0 identically (no quantum structure)
criterion_1_finitude_vs_flat.flat_control_description: alpha=0 gives pure product |00> for system ABE; I(A:B)=S_A+S_B-S_AB=0 for any product state (standard QIT). NOTE: this is a DIFFERENT STATE (never entangled), NOT the product-erasure tautology (which applies a map to rho_AB). Flat R^N Euclidean space would also give I(A:B)=0 everywhere (no quantum structure, no finite cut complex).
criterion_1_finitude_vs_flat.verdict: MET: genuine min I(A:B) > 0.1 (bounded nonzero quantum cut structure); flat/product control gives I(A:B)=0 (collapses to zero). Non-flatness load-bearing for F01.

criterion_2_noncommutation.clifford_note: No Clifford sublevel in this density-operator object; anticommutator {Gamma_a,Gamma_b}=2delta check not applicable.
criterion_2_noncommutation.description: cut-crossing channels (dephase_B, rotB) do not commute on entangled cut states (tilted B-frame makes dephasing axis non-aligned with cut correlation)
criterion_2_noncommutation.flat_control_description: rho_A (x) I/2: maximally mixed B subsystem. ALL unitaries U_B leave I/2 invariant: U_B*(I/2)*U_B†=I/2. Dephasing also leaves I/2 invariant. Both channel orderings give the SAME result -> order gap = 0 exactly. This is the geometric flat/Cartesian limit: no B-subsystem structure means no sensitivity to channel ordering.
criterion_2_noncommutation.input_dependence_note: not part of the channel-order N01 pass bar; L12 input dependence is carried by the I(A:B) and collapse dependency-forcing section
criterion_2_noncommutation.verdict: MET: cut-crossing channel order gap > 1e-3 (structurally nonzero on the cut family); flat/product control gap < 1e-9 (zero). Non-flatness load-bearing for N01.

criterion_3_topological_invariant.verdict: MET: chi_wrong=8 != chi_genuine=1 -> topology FLIPPED by wrong structure.
criterion_3_topological_invariant.wrong_structure_description: disconnect the complex: E=0, F=0, C=0 -> chi_wrong=V; isolated vertices have no topological connectivity. For any non-trivial grid chi_wrong=V != chi_genuine -> FLIPS.

criterion_4_exact_carrier.carrier_type: Julia-native dense ComplexF64 4x4 density matrices; exact arithmetic
criterion_4_exact_carrier.contraction_error_bound: exact dense; discretization error is O(machine precision) ~ 1e-16; claimed effect (I(A:B) > 0.1) >> 1e-16
criterion_4_exact_carrier.equal_truncation_budget: genuine and control states use identical construction; no MPS bond truncation applied
criterion_4_exact_carrier.verdict: MET: exact Julia-native dense arithmetic; no CTMRG; equal budget.

criterion_5_scale_ladder.verdict: 4/4 rungs: collapse+anti-taut+finitude+N01+topology re-measured at each K

criterion_6_neural_dynamics.description: Hopfield-style attractor on the cut geometry: memories are stored alpha* values (cut angles encoding entanglement strengths); energy = |I(A:B)(alpha) - I(A:B)(alpha*)|; retrieval via gradient descent on the cut-angle parameter space; I(A:B) is the order parameter tracking convergence (holonomy analog for L12).
criterion_6_neural_dynamics.non_flatness_role: flat/product baseline has I(A:B)=0 everywhere -> no energy landscape -> no attractor basin -> no retrieval possible. Non-flat cut geometry provides a curved I(A:B) landscape whose basin structure enables retrieval.
criterion_6_neural_dynamics.verdict: MET: cut-geometry attractor converges to stored memory in <=20 steps; I(A:B) shifts by >0.01 during retrieval; two memories distinguishable by I(A:B) gap>0.05.

finite_map.F01: compact finite cut complex; all I(A:B) bounded in [0,log2]; flat/product control gives I(A:B)=0 (collapses)
finite_map.N01: cut-crossing channels do not commute on entangled cut states; flat/product control gives zero order gap; noncommutation is input-dependent
finite_map.codomain: per-cut rho_AB(v) + DERIVED readout (S_A,S_B,S_AB,I_c,I(A:B)) + N01 order gap + topological invariant chi + attractor basin membership
finite_map.domain: PEPS3D cut cells v of K=(V,E,F,C); each carries a purified |psi_ABE(v)>, angle alpha(v) from a Hopf-latitude sweep, B-half tilted by a fixed generic unitary

genuine_geometry_reuse: psi/rho_AB_from_ket/entangled_cut (GHZ-type purified cut with B-tilt), cut_alpha/cut_beta/cut_family (Hopf-latitude sweep), dephase_B/rotB/zx/xz/cut_readouts, peps3d_complex, anti-tautology local-unitary control, structural co-diagonality check, all thresholds.

commutation.threshold: genuine>1e-3 AND flat<1e-6; input dependence recorded separately in dependency-forcing

exact_carrier.threshold: exact dense, no CTMRG, rho valid

neural_dynamics.threshold: converged AND steps<=20 AND delta_I>0.01 AND mem_gap>0.05
